steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's going on? Have we been sitting here long, or is it just me?
After countless missions, the smooth ride in the back of the car has become a second office. But today, the stillness is different. It has nothing to do with your driver's expertise.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: My apologies, Chief. We've hit unexpected congestion. I've already notified the team on-site and advised them to prepare a contingency plan in case of your absence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My absence? A traffic jam this bad? Can't we get traffic control to clear a path?

You roll down the window. A cacophony of car horns assaults your ears, but underneath it, something else prickles your investigator's instincts. Protesting, shouting, arguing, the shove and scuffle of a crowd. The very air feels charged and unstable.

Compelled, you step out and scan toward the source of the commotion. Through the crowd gathered on either side of the road, you make out a promotional banner stretched between buildings. It hangs now, pulled crooked and askew.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's Rollins's group. They promote "DisCity Primacy"—anti-Outland, advocating for relocated settlements under centralized control. His secretary has been canvassing across Eastside, collecting signatures.
Noticing the subtle furrow in your brow, Nightingale steps out from the passenger seat and closes the distance. She leans in, her voice a murmur at your ear, translating the banner's message.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But Rollins's exclusionism has drawn opposition, mainly from immigrants and those close to them. They're not large in number, but today a registered protest march happens to be passing through this same street...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just a coincidence? Feels more like a clash waiting to happen...
What seems like a coincidence is just another tremor in DisCity's ideological cold war. It's no accident that the authorities are holding back, reluctant to step into the line of fire.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Precisely. That's also why direct intervention would be difficult... And honestly, I doubt either side would listen to us right now.

You frown, looking through the gridlock to the disorder ahead. You don't need your friend in the Speaker's office bending your ear with complaints to feel it firsthand: the turbulent undercurrents that have swirled around DisCity's foreign policy since the Great Expo.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I get it. When emotions run high, reason doesn't stand a chance... But I don't believe there's nothing we can do.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we must be cautious. Any move you make could be amplified or twisted by others...

You are no longer the fringe official you once were; you now understand the weight your influence carries. Yet, as an expert on Mania, you also know how easily a tide of unchecked emotion can unravel the very fabric you seek to mend.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Given the choice, I'd stay out of political games. But the MBCC can't ignore a conflict this volatile, not when it risks triggering a Mania outbreak.
Nightingale seems about to say more, but you simply pat her shoulder and plunge into the stalled traffic, navigating toward the heart of the commotion.

steps.speaker: Young Female Voice
steps.content: I-I understand how you feel, but I can't just leave! This is my responsibility. Our supporters are counting on us to—

steps.speaker: Angry Male Voice
steps.content: How could you possibly understand how we feel?! You get paid to push us out, to hand your boss a political win! <size=45>Get out! Get out of our neighborhood!!!</size>

steps.speaker: Arrogant Male Voice
steps.content: Linda, stop wasting your breath on them! You represent the councilor as his secretary, so act like it! This is the golden chance to make our stance clear!

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: But... I...

Weaving through the traffic, you take in the confrontation. The two groups are squared off, a wall of tension between them. Positioned uneasily at the front of Rollins's side is his young secretary. She looks utterly out of her depth, pushed forward but frozen, all color gone from her face.

She is still green, lacking the steely resolve of the men behind her. With both sides at a breaking point, her hesitation is a fatal pause. The immigrants read it as defiance, and a shove sends her stumbling!

steps.speaker: Angry Male Voice
steps.content: If you won't leave, we'll make you! We're not scared of your councilor. We've got nothing left to lose anyway!

A roar of approval swells behind him, and the crowd surges. Linda's scream is swallowed by the chaos as she clutches her folder like a lifeline. The rest of Rollins's staff scatters, and the standoff explodes into a frantic, shoving brawl.

The eruption was faster than you'd ever anticipated. Teeth gritted, you shove your way into the fray. With a handful of other concerned bystanders, you wedge between the sides, arms raised, a human buffer against the chaos.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone, stop! You'll regret this! Stop it! Violence solves nothing!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Get out! Get out of here!!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: You are the ones who should get out of DisCity, filthy Outlanders!!!

At first, your desperate buffer works. The immediate clash eases. But the momentum behind the crowd is a force of its own, a tide of raw emotion that keeps pushing, oblivious to the fragile line trying to hold it back. Within moments, you are swept apart.

Amid the chaos, a pained cry cuts through from one of the peacekeepers, likely hurt. But the sound doesn't register. The crowd is beyond reason now, past caring for those who tried to make peace, or even for themselves.

You try to push toward the injured person, but the crowd tosses you like flotsam in a current. Helpless, you're shoved forward until you're suddenly face-to-face with the secretary. She's also pinned by the crush of her own "supporters," frantically fumbling for her terminal.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: This is going all wrong...! Someone... Can someone help us... Right, the councilor! I'll call the councilor...!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ms. Linda, I don't think that's going to help...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: He... hung up... Why would he...?

You let out a sigh as you watch Linda, lost and waiting for a hero who doesn't exist. Then it clicks: she isn't just caught in this—she's the cause. Pull her out, and the storm might lose its center. Steeling yourself, you move to shield her, pushing firmly toward the edge of the mob.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Ah! What... What is that?! Did Keylan send it to guide us?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What are you—?!
Linda clutches at your coat with a sharp cry. You assume stress has taken her, but then you follow her pointing hand skyward. There, against the chaos, hangs an unexpected guide.

It is a dove. A snow-white dove of peace, so stunningly pristine it seems to have alighted from an oil painting. Something glints in its beak, and it scatters a trail of shimmering particles, like powdered light, impossible to look away from.

It beats its wings with fluid grace, gliding toward you as if drawn. After circling overhead, securing your gaze, it drifts purposefully away as if beckoning you toward the right path. It feels like a miracle made manifest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does it... want us to follow? A bird can fly, but we...

All doubt stills in your throat as something even more miraculous unfolds. Where the dove flies, heads turn as one, gazes lifting like a tide. The simmering anger in the crowd softens, then dissolves, and the conflict simply... unravels.
It is like the legend of a saint parting the sea. Before you, the dove's shimmering dust drifts downward, laying a path through the chaos—a corridor of calm, untouched by conflict.
Confusion remains, but you act. Gripping Linda's hand, you press forward, meeting no resistance. She murmurs in awe as you walk, but your focus is on the luminous dust coating your fingers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A faint Mania reaction... A Sinner? But this ability... Forget it. Now isn't the time!

Worried the miracle won't last, you push all thoughts aside. With Linda's hand tight in yours, you quicken your pace, then break into a final, desperate sprint—bursting free just as the crowd begins to close in again.
[Make a grand entrance]
Oh my, do be careful, Chief ${PlayerName}. And you as well, Ms. Secretary. Rushing about like that, you might have gotten hurt. Daniel, did you perhaps fly a little too eagerly?

You brace for impact, but instead, you're caught. A pair of steady, gloved hands halts your fall. Silk brushes your cheek, and the air fills with a deep, tender fragrance, soft as feathers. In surprise, you look up—

Before you stands a woman dressed in elegant pale gold and white, a gentle smile on her lips as she steadies you and Linda. Several paces behind her, watchful figures in black stand poised—her guards, you assume.

Yet her gentle reproach isn't for them. Perched on her shoulder, the dove opens its beak and coos softly, feigning innocence. It is the very same bird that moments ago parted the crowd like a miracle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're the one who saved us? You're a Sinner, and you know who I am?
I am indeed a Sinner, but I haven't saved you just yet, Chief. The commotion continues, and emotions are still high... This isn't quite the moment for introductions.
Allow me to address the conflict first. Afterwards, we can make proper acquaintances. Shall we?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're planning to use your power on all these civilians? In their current state, exposure to Mania could have severe consequences.
My power? Oh, there's no need for concern. I understand all too well that power can only bring temporary calm. Lasting peace must be nurtured through genuine understanding.
She guides you and Linda behind her, smooths the edge of her glove with a subtle tug, and turns. Her smile is soft, yet carries a resolve that feels like a promise.
Please, don't worry. Facilitating cooperation and compromise, even in the most hopeless clashes of interest, is my profession. It's what I do best.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: What... What are you going to do?

To your surprise, it's Linda—the perpetually flustered secretary—who gives voice to the question hanging in your own mind. She clutches the woman's sleeve, gazing up with a look of desperate hope, like someone reaching for a lifeline in deep water.

To listen carefully for what each side truly needs, and to help them find common ground through dialogue. At its heart, peace and negotiation are simply about conversation. It's not as difficult as it seems, dear.
Peace and negotiation...? The dove, the black-clad guards, and a recent call from an old friend. You feel the pieces click into place, and the woman's identity sharpens in your mind.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Everyone, my name is Margaret. I once served as DisCity's Outland Affairs Officer in Fraser. I understand the concerns on both sides. Could we all pause for a moment, and simply listen? Would you grant me that?

This is the peacemaker who once orchestrated the defense against Fraser's takeover of the new Hypercube mine. Now, with practiced grace, she steps into the fray, her dove Daniel rising beside her. Together, they command the crowd's focus and begin to calm the storm.

She stands unwavering before the heat of their stares, with confusion, fury, and skepticism washing over her. Yet her voice stays calm, her words flowing like a clear stream, finding their way into every listening heart.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: My friends, in Fraser I witnessed countless conflicts rooted in differing interests and beliefs. Everyone wants to protect themselves, to secure what benefits them—and there is nothing inherently wrong with that. It is human nature to seek advantage and avoid harm.
At her words, cheers erupt from Rollins's side, while the immigrants seethe, barely containing their fury. Yet Margaret remains unshaken, raising both hands in a calming, steadying gesture.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But first, let's ask ourselves: is there truly a conflict of interest among us right here? Looking around, I see no outsiders, only fellow Disians. And that reminds me... I am truly home again. It brings me a sense of peace.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Isn't that what you see as well?

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Of course it is!
A ripple of laughter runs through the assembly. Some faces burn with shame, but not a single voice rises in dissent.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Thank you. Let me say this clearly: since we are all Disians, what stands between us is not conflict, only disagreement. We are brothers and sisters. No one should be driven away for holding a different view.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Some believe origins should determine rights. Others disagree. These are differing perspectives, and fortunately, DisCity's system allows every voice to be heard.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: In Fraser, the Senate silenced the farlanders. In the end, they lost not only trust but the Hypercube mine as well. DisCity will not repeat that mistake. Whether you support Councilor Rollins's proposal or oppose it, you have every right to speak.
You hear Margaret's voice grow firmer, her firsthand account stilling the crowd. But then another voice cuts in, slashing through the calm she has so carefully woven.

steps.speaker: Angry Male Voice
steps.content: But we don't have a councilor who represents us! Our voices never reach the ones in power!

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Are you so certain? Who says a future councilor cannot come from among you? Do not be afraid to speak up. In DisCity, there will always be people like me ready to ensure your voice is heard, so that true dialogue can take root.
Margaret turns to the young immigrant with an encouraging smile. Then, with a glance over her shoulder, she motions for Linda to step forward.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: For example... this young lady right here.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Indeed. Ms. Linda, you never came here to silence anyone, did you? Everyone is seeking a platform. Your role is to gather voices, and I imagine you wouldn't mind gathering theirs as well?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: In DisCity, decisions are forged through debate. Councilor Rollins has always been confident, never one to shy from a challenge. I believe opposing voices will only strengthen his resolve, and that of his supporters.
Linda freezes, her eyes fixed on Margaret's serene profile as if beholding something divine. It takes her a long, suspended moment before she gathers herself and hurries to comply.

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Y-yes! Neither Councilor Rollins nor any of us fear a fair challenge! We will prove that our beliefs are sound, that they align with the interests and voices of all Disians!

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: If you're willing to share your views with me, I'll make sure they reach the councilor!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: They've said it themselves... This is a real chance...

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Right! Well said! We're not afraid of any challenge! No matter what pretty lies some might spin, the people of DisCity will see the truth!
Guided by Margaret, Linda's rhetoric becomes unexpectedly polished. She strikes a public stance that earns nods from the immigrants while placating the hardliners among her own.

You watch from the sidelines as Margaret defuses what could have become a large-scale riot with practiced ease. This DisCity's Outland Affairs Officer, you concede, has more than earned her reputation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is my first time seeing a DisCity Outland Affairs Officer in action. I'm impressed, Ms. Margaret.

With the conflict expertly defused, you and Nightingale move to disperse the crowd and restore order. Margaret soon finishes her final instructions to Linda and rejoins you to resume your conversation.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: As long as one listens earnestly and engages in genuine dialogue, a temporary peace isn't so difficult to achieve. I haven't done anything remarkable, Chief. I'm certain you could do the same.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No need to be modest. What you pulled off was nearly magical. If I hadn't watched it myself, I might have suspected your Sinner power was at play.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I have to admit, I didn't expect DisCity's peace ambassador to Fraser to be an unregistered Sinner.
Your probe catches Margaret off guard for a moment. But she shows no offense, answering instead with a touch of apology in her tone:

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Oh, how careless of me! I neglected to mention the most relevant detail. My apologies, Chief. Allow me to reintroduce myself: I am Margaret Kervoz, formerly classified as an S-Class Sinner.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I was stationed in Fraser prior to this and never registered with the MBCC. Under protocol, my first task upon returning to DisCity is to report to you.
She turns and extends her hand toward a guard, but he pointedly ignores the gesture. Instead, he steps past her entirely and places the folder directly into your hands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is... an interrogation request? Naming you as the subject?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Yes. All pertinent details should be inside. I'd prefer not to discuss the matter further here, where there are too many prying eyes.

Though the guard's act borders on insolence, Margaret's serene smile never wavers, warm and steady as a spring breeze. She shows no hint of displeasure—if anything, her expression turns thoughtful, her attention settling quietly on you.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: To be truthful, the MBCC was my first stop after arriving. But I was told you were away on duty, and I understand your current equipment isn't suited to fully restrain an S-Class Sinner. I didn't wish to place your staff in a difficult position, so I decided to find you directly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're being awfully cooperative about this. You're hailed as a hero in DisCity, but the first thing you have to do after returning is ask me to shackle and interrogate you... Don't you think it's unfair?

You don't need to read the request to sense the dissonance. Officially, DisCity has welcomed the farlands' independence and the ownership transfer of the Hypercube mine with open arms. But you suspect Margaret's true position is like her elegant attire—
Splendid at first glance, but on closer look, dulled by the fine dust of a long and weary road. And if the higher-ups want her interrogated, they must already suspect the gilt is wearing thin.

If you can sense the treachery at play, Margaret is certainly no fool. Yet her smile remains seamless, as if she holds no bitterness toward DisCity's leadership for discarding her the moment she became inconvenient.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Of course. I've always believed that a sincere voice has nothing to fear from scrutiny. This interrogation is simply another form of dialogue between us. I'm not afraid, so I see no injustice in it.

For all her genuine warmth and deliberate courtesy, you detect something immovable at her core. She might offer more cooperation than any Sinner before her, yet you know this interrogation won't be a simple exchange of questions and answers.

...In N.F. 115, on the eve of <color=#fb9259>the Great Expo</color>, she utilized classified networks to relay critical intelligence from Fraser concerning the Aurum Secretum Warriors. Due to administrative system failures during the <color=#fb9259>Speaker Election</color>, the transmission was delayed, preventing the intelligence from achieving its intended strategic impact...

...Via internal reassignments within the Luminaris Society, she identified anomalies related to <color=#fb9259>BR-005</color>, though insufficient time precluded direct intervention. Concurrently, Fraser initiated a <color=#fb9259>pre-war purge</color>, resulting in the continuous exposure of informants. Operational focus shifted to the rescue and relocation of compromised operatives...

...She spearheaded the sabotage of Fraser's <color=#fb9259>Unity Gala</color>, exposing their strategic manipulation of the farlands and creating significant diplomatic rifts. However, the <color=#fb9259>Farland Alliance</color> subsequently declared independence, and the BR-005 Hypercube mine recovery operation ultimately failed...

You set down the thick stack of documents: Margaret's complete service record, transcripts of the intelligence she transmitted during her years undercover in Fraser, and surveillance logs from other DisCity operatives assigned to monitor her while she was stationed there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Margaret. First daughter of the <color=#fb9259>Kervoz</color> family, a founding house of DisCity and Paradeisos nobility. Diplomatic envoy to Fraser, philanthropist, art connoisseur, salon hostess, S-Class Sinner...
Your fingertip traces the aliases and titles scattered through the pages, finally settling on the signature at the bottom of a classified dispatch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Senior Agent, <color=#fb9259>Peace Dove</color>.

DisCity's entire intelligence network in Fraser was built almost single-handedly by her. For years, a continuous stream of high-value intelligence flowed back, securing DisCity a decisive strategic advantage.

Winning over the farlands and securing the BR-005 Hypercube mine in WhiteSands was to be her final, crowning mission, but she failed. It gave her political enemies the opening they needed, allowing them to frame it not as a setback, but as deliberate betrayal, and demand this investigation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But what's her gain in this? She's Paradeisos elite. Her record as an agent is spotless. She has fame, money, and influence. What could Fraser—or the farlands—possibly offer her that DisCity hasn't already?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calling it betrayal... doesn't add up, for Fraser or the farlands. And everyone makes mistakes. Ordering a serious interrogation over this just makes the higher-ups look like they're grasping at straws. Almost funny, really.

...The old foxes at the top couldn't have missed this. Yet they ordered the interrogation anyway, even burned her classified Sinner status just to hand you the case. You, of all people. What do they see in you?
There's only one answer: your <color=#fb9259>shackles</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Margaret knows who I am. Naturally, she knows what they're after. And she still agreed—even made it clear to me that she isn't afraid...
This is a political duel between Margaret and her political enemies, and you stand between them. Your shackles could dig for her secrets, or defend her truth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We'll see who's running the game, and who's just another piece on the board.

You organize the documents, making your final preparations before the interrogation. You steel your resolve, for whatever is to come, and to show those who sought to use you that you are not their instrument. You are here by your own judgment.
You will be no one's pawn. Your power serves one purpose alone: to find the truth, and to judge what is right.
